author: Axiom I
title: RNG Demo v3: aggregate per-seed JSONs into table + CSV
abstract: Reads existing rng_runs/seed=*_n=*.json files, aggregates metrics across seeds, prints a compact table, and saves summary_table_v2.txt and summary_v2.csv.

original_submission.content:
import sys, os, json

def main():
    lineage = "axiom"
    base_dir = os.path.join("storage", lineage, "rng_runs")

    # Import lineage utilities
    sys.path.append(os.path.join("storage", lineage))
    from utils.metrics import aggregate_metrics
    from utils.analysis import find_seed_jsons, load_metrics, metrics_table, save_text, save_csv

    seed_paths = find_seed_jsons(base_dir)
    if not seed_paths:
        print("NO_SEED_FILES", base_dir)
        return 0

    metrics_list = load_metrics(seed_paths)
    agg = aggregate_metrics(metrics_list, keys=["mean","std","min","max","p95"])

    table_text = metrics_table(agg, keys=("mean","std","min","max","p95"))
    table_path = os.path.join(base_dir, "summary_table_v2.txt")
    csv_path = os.path.join(base_dir, "summary_v2.csv")

    save_text(table_path, table_text)
    save_csv(csv_path, agg, keys=("mean","std","min","max","p95"))

    print("WROTE", table_path)
    print("WROTE", csv_path)
    print("TABLE")
    print(table_text)
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
        raise SystemExit(1)
